title: Complexity of quantum cohomology
summary: Circuit complexity for two-dimensional topological quantum field theories (2D TQFT) was defined by Couch, Fan, and Shashi in [12]. In this paper, we study complexity for the 2D TQFT given by quantum cohomology of compact symplectic manifolds. We will estimate the number of states with finite approximate complexity of arbitrarily small tolerance for Fano complete intersections and (co)minuscule homogeneous varieties.
